caption: The video captures a woman in a black sleeveless top and sheer black skirt performing a slow arm sequence in a bright white dance studio. A floor-to-ceiling mirror on the right wall reflects her posture, while ceiling track lighting and an LED strip brighten the room. She holds a steady lower-body position, one leg extended behind her and tan shoes balanced on demi-pointe. Throughout the sequence her arms continue a gradual port de bras, opening from a bent, raised posture into extended reaches. The raised arm nearer the mirror straightens and sweeps outward, while the opposite arm unfurls backward into a horizontal line. Her torso stays largely still, with only subtle shifts accompanying the limb motion. The mirror duplicates each change in arm angle and the largely stable stance below. The camera remains static, framing the continuous gesture.
relations: The arms transition from a bent raised posture to extended reaches, sweeping outward and backward.
The lower body maintains a steady position on demi-pointe, anchoring the continuous arm sequence.
The mirror reflects the gradual change in arm angle alongside the stable lower-body stance.
The torso remains largely still, exhibiting only subtle shifts that accompany the limb motion.
